title: Technical Support Specialist
company: Agensi Pekerjaan & Perundingcara Bright Prospect Sdn Bhd
job_description:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, MIS, or related field At least 4 years of experience in IT infrastructure, MIS, or systems engineering roles Strong knowledge of networking, server administration, and virtualization Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring tools Familiarity with EDR or cybersecurity operations is an advantage Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently or in a team.

Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues for laptops, desktops, and peripherals Troubleshoot network connectivity (wired/wireless, switches, Wi-Fi, VPN) Configure, monitor, and maintain network devices (switches, access points) Administer Windows and Linux servers (physical and virtual) Manage virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent) Implement and monitor backup, replication, and disaster recovery solutions Monitor infrastructure including networks, servers, virtual machines, and system services Respond to and manage Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) alerts Serve as an escalation point for technical incidents and perform root cause analysis Maintain accurate system, monitoring, and recovery documentation

Annual Leave EPF SOCSO Dental Optical Insurance coverage immediate family (spouse and kids) Medical and Hospitalisation Leave Annual Bonus EIS Medical Insurance Training Provided Performance Bonus 5 Working Days

IT Infrastructure Support Windows & Linux Server Administration Network Troubleshooting Switches Wi-Fi & VPN Configuration Virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V) Backup & Disaster Recovery Infrastructure Monitoring Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) Root Cause Analysis Hardware & Software Troubleshooting System Documentation Cybersecurity Operations Mandarin Communication
